items.prompt: An instrumented binary cannot initialize its runtime in the current environment. What should the report say?

options.text: The learner implementation passed memory safety
The sanitizer check is unavailable/failed setup, not passed
options.why: Investigate environment and retain ordinary test evidence separately.

options.text: All ordinary tests must be deleted
Suppress stderr and count the exit as success
options.why: That would hide the actual outcome.

items.explanation: Distinguish unavailable instrumentation from a source violation and from a successful run.
